Street panoramas: Nanjing, Baidu street view (© Baidu). Grades from Cheng, Chu, Zong, Li, Wu & Li (2017), ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information 6, 265, doi:10.3390/ijgi6090265.

config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu 360° street panoramas of Jianye District, Nanjing, shown flat (the middle band of the panorama), not the paper's Tencent panoramas, since Tencent Street View is no longer available. Participants grade each panorama in five classes from 1 (lowest or worst) to 5 (highest or best) on visual brilliance, richness, green quantity, sky area and general landscape, the scores Cheng, Chu, Zong, Li, Wu & Li (2017, ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information) used to check their salient region saturation, visual entropy, green view and sky openness indices. Differences from the original study: (1) the paper had 100 volunteers (50 from the area, 50 online) grade 84 panoramas taken 600 m apart; here each participant grades 20 random panoramas; (2) residence in the area is recorded.

paper.title: Use of Tencent Street View imagery for visual perception of streets
